articles.description: Victor Osimhen, Maduka Okoye and Kelechi Iheanacho were missing as Nigeria coach Eric Chelle named his 24-man squad for the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifying double-header against Tanzania.

images.name: Maduka Okoye [1296x729]

articles.headline: Post-match chaos sours Victor Osimhen brace in Galatasaray win over Fenerbahce
articles.description: Victor Osimhen warned of chaos ahead of Monday's Istanbul derby against Fenerbahce, and it duly arrived after the final whistle, as the Nigeria striker scored both goals in Galatasaray's 2-1 victory.
